# mini-unreachable

Computes phonon band structures. The method is described in the companion paper
(please cite). **No local copy of the paper is bundled**, and the homepage is
unreachable in fixture mode.

The point of this fixture is the tri-state slot rule: a claimed paper that cannot
be read is `state: "unknown"`, not `0`. The repo entry alone must not install or
refuse the product.
